papers.summary_zh: 分析门控DeltaNet-2的循环状态不稳定问题，并提出缓解方法，使线性注意力在长序列建模中更稳定。

papers.title: OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
papers.summary: A live cross-platform benchmark evaluates computer-using agents on long-horizon workflows across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web, showing that current agents remain far from platform-robust computer use and trail humans on iOS and macOS.
papers.summary_zh: 提出跨平台基准OS-Omni，评测计算机智能体在多平台长流程任务上的表现，发现其仍远逊于人类。

papers.title: Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
papers.summary: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfoldi
papers.summary_zh: 研究发现，让编码智能体用代码求解视觉推理问题，效果优于视频生成模型。

papers.title: What a Forecasting Leaderboard Can Establish: Resolution Reporting for Zero-Shot Time-Series Models
papers.summary: A tool called Vernier measures the smallest score difference a time-series forecasting leaderboard can distinguish, showing that most boards cannot separate top entries and that ranking order can change with pool composition.
papers.summary_zh: 提出Vernier工具，发现多数时间序列预测排行榜无法区分顶尖模型，且排名会随候选池变化。

papers.title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
papers.summary: A benchmark assesses how well video generators follow animated 3D blockouts while preserving structure, filling missing content, correcting proxy artifacts, and binding multimodal conditions to the correct entities and events.
papers.summary_zh: 提出ProxyGenBench基准，评估视频生成器依据3D代理模型生成视频时保持结构、补全内容与绑定条件的能力。

papers.title: Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
papers.summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates. In robotic manipulation, a human video provides the context that specifies how a task should be performed. However, scaling human-video ICL on world-action models (WAMs) faces two chal
papers.summary_zh: 提出Entangle，将人类视频上下文学习扩展到世界-动作模型，使机器人能在未见任务和场景中执行操作。

papers.title: StateWeaver: Multi-Agent Coordination of Story-State Transitions for Long-Horizon Video Generation
papers.summary: StateWeaver improves long-video generation by preserving cross-shot consistency and updating visual references through active state tracking and hierarchical collaboration.
papers.summary_zh: 提出StateWeaver多智能体框架，通过故事状态追踪与分层协作，保持长视频镜头间一致性并更新视觉参考。

papers.title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
papers.summary: Integral converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space, preserving understanding while enabling strong visual generation.
papers.summary_zh: 提出Integral，将预训练视觉语言模型转为统一多模态模型，通过共享视觉表示空间同时实现理解与图像生成。

papers.title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
papers.summary: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how de
papers.summary_zh: 提出以知识为中心的DRBench Pro基准，评估专业深度研究智能体报告覆盖了哪些研究方向及其知识质量。

papers.title: Playfulness as Feedback for Agentic Game Development
papers.summary: Play2Evolve uses AI agents to iteratively playtest, diagnose, and improve generated games through initialization, refinement, and evolution stages, enhancing functionality, visuals, and gameplay quality.
papers.summary_zh: 提出Play2Evolve框架，让智能体迭代试玩、诊断并改进生成的游戏，提升功能、画面与玩法质量。

papers.title: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
papers.summary: A fine-grained speculative streaming framework prepares action-conditioned video futures during playback to reduce input-to-display latency in interactive world models while sustaining real-time generation.
papers.summary_zh: 提出ShowNow细粒度推测式流式生成框架，在播放时预生成动作条件视频，降低交互式世界模型的显示延迟。

papers.title: DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data
papers.summary: A growing body of recent work addresses the retargeting of human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands. To train whole-robot policies, however, the retargeted motions must be kinematically feasible and physically executable, and be produced efficiently at scale. We present DexEngine, a simulat
papers.summary_zh: 提出DexEngine仿真框架，将人类手-物体演示转化为可物理执行的全机器人数据，用于大规模训练机器人策略。

papers.title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
papers.summary: Model-driven context management through a context API improves accuracy and token efficiency over harness-triggered compaction, while reusing KV caches after edits reduces prefill compute.
papers.summary_zh: 通过上下文API让模型自主管理上下文，比框架触发的压缩更准确、更省token，编辑后复用KV缓存可降低计算量。

papers.title: WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
papers.summary: WorldBridge generates coherent and controllable 3D worlds from scattered, low-overlap images by encoding references into a global scene context and using attention and latent-reference consistency optimization.
papers.summary_zh: 提出WorldBridge，将分散、低重叠的多视角图像编码为全局场景上下文，生成连贯可控的3D世界。

papers.title: Boundary-Aware Policy Learning for Agent-Orchestrated Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: A method that explicitly shapes and expands the handoff boundary of visuomotor policies improves coordination between multimodal agents and robot policies, yielding higher success and lower cost.
papers.summary_zh: 提出一种显式塑造视觉运动策略交接边界的方法，改善多模态智能体与机器人策略间的协作，提高成功率并降低成本。

papers.title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
papers.summary: A systematic study of harness design for long-horizon self-evolving autoresearch agents finds that context folding and selective skill deletion improve performance, enabling MLEvolver to achieve strong results on MLE-Bench Lite and KernelBench Level 3.
papers.summary_zh: 系统研究自进化自动研究智能体的框架设计，发现上下文折叠与选择性删除技能可提升性能，并据此构建MLEvolver。

papers.title: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
papers.summary: Decision models are language models fine-tuned to return a probability for each option of a typed query, which routers and guardrails threshold directly. They are built on multilingual bases but ranked almost entirely in English. We evaluate 25 top-ranked open-weight decision models on 17 tasks in 1
papers.summary_zh: 评测25个顶尖开源决策模型在17项多语言任务上的表现，发现其非英语场景下表现不佳，并提出校准方法。

papers.title: Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock
papers.summary: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising a
papers.summary_zh: 指出主动式任务助手应依据视频证据而非时钟判断何时提示，现有基准多奖励时机判断而非视觉理解。

papers.title: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers
papers.summary: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task b
papers.summary_zh: 重新审视大语言模型作为上下文工程师的方法，梳理自动化构建指令提示与元数据以引导模型的相关研究。

papers.title: When an AI agent makes a mistake in a database, what decides the damage?
papers.summary: AI agents now run statements against production databases, and several of the incidents that followed deleted production data, which came back only through backups or the provider's help. We ask what decides the damage when such an agent makes a mistake: the model, a guard layer in front of the data
papers.summary_zh: 分析AI智能体在生产数据库中误操作时，损失大小由模型、前置防护层还是数据库本身决定。
